title: Interventions lifted incomes above state averages in all three focus states

sections.heading: Reach
sections.body: Programs reached **3M farmers directly** and 3M more through diffusion in AY 2024-25, with digital channels adding **66M** touchpoints across advisory, market linkage and DPI rails.

sections.heading: Income
sections.body: Direct-beneficiary households out-earned state averages in every geography — **+2.7%** in Uttar Pradesh, **+5%** in Bihar and **+4.8%** in Odisha from crops and livestock.

sections.heading: Resilience
sections.body: Advisory recipients cut crop losses by **2-8 percentage points**, worth $14-31 per farmer per season depending on state.

sections.heading: Leverage
sections.body: Government and private partners co-invested **$1,426 Mn** against program funding, with a 64% adoption rate of programmatic interventions.
